what: `set -euo pipefail` can exit before `CLEARED`/`SEEDED` KVs are emitted
scenario_or_breakage: Plan requires `CLEARED=false` / `SEEDED=false` on temp-read, `mv`, or dest-read failure, but an uncaught `mktemp`, `awk`, or `read-session-env-key.sh` failure will abort the script without emitting the machine key; orchestrator then sees missing KV / non-zero and mis-routes (same class as failure mode 1)
suggested_fix: Wrap the write/read/mv chain in explicit `|| { emit_kv … false; exit … }` handlers (or a local err trap that emits then re-exits); do not rely on bare `set -e` alone
